data.description:
## Description

What: Wire the require_codeql and require_code_quality knobs into the cross-repo CREATE path. The /dso:onboarding security step writes both keys to dso-config.conf (default false) at project setup, and github-bootstrap.sh -> provision-ruleset.sh reads those keys and applies the corresponding ruleset rules on a ci-pr project. Why: Per the Knob Lifecycle Owner block, /dso:onboarding is the declared CREATE owner for these knobs; draft-3 scopes onboarding OUT and only wires the provision-ruleset.sh consume path. Without this story the knobs are dead config that no setup path ever writes or applies (red/blue accepted finding 1, sc_coverage_gap). Scope IN: onboarding security-step config emission (both keys, default false); github-bootstrap.sh -> provision-ruleset.sh pass-through; a config-isolated test covering both. Scope OUT: the provision-ruleset.sh knob implementation itself (draft-3), enabling the rules on the DSO repo (draft-4), the CI jobs (draft-1/draft-2).


## Done Definitions

- The /dso:onboarding security step writes both require_codeql and require_code_quality keys to dso-config.conf, each defaulting to false, during project setup ← Satisfies: sc-3
- github-bootstrap.sh invokes provision-ruleset.sh passing the require_codeql and require_code_quality values read from dso-config.conf, applying them on a ci-pr project ← Satisfies: sc-3
- A configuration-isolated test (HOME set to an empty directory, no global git config, no pre-set environment variables, no pre-existing dso-config.conf) asserts that onboarding emits both keys defaulting to false AND that github-bootstrap.sh passes them through to provision-ruleset.sh, and the test passes ← Satisfies: sc-3

## Considerations

- [Cross-repo ownership] Per the Knob Lifecycle Owner block, /dso:onboarding is the CREATE owner and provision-ruleset.sh (draft-3) is the CONSUME owner; this story closes the orphaned CREATE half so the two knobs are written and applied end-to-end.
- [Compatibility] Both keys default to false so onboarding a project that has not opted in preserves existing provisioning behavior; only an explicit true emits the rule.
- [Sequencing] depends_on draft-3 is load-bearing: github-bootstrap.sh can only pass the knobs through once provision-ruleset.sh accepts them.

## Escalation Policy

**Escalation policy**: Proceed unless a significant assumption is required to continue — one that could send the implementation in the wrong direction. Escalate only when genuinely blocked without a reasonable inference. Document all assumptions made without escalating.
data.title: As a DSO operator onboarding a new project, I want the /dso:onboarding security step to write require_codeql/require_code_quality to dso-config.conf and github-bootstrap.sh to apply them
